overview: Rounds out vanilla cooking: smoking as a craft of its own, cheese, pies, stews and drinks, and reasons to eat something other than whichever food has the biggest number.
Nothing here needs a new station. The smoker, the furnace, the campfire, the barrel and the crafting grid do all of it.

1.2.2: The smoker's fuel slot takes every offcut the firebox will burn.
Planks, stairs, slabs, gates and signs were refused at the screen while the firebox would have burned them.
1.2.1: A smoker takes wooden blocks from other mods too, not only the shapes vanilla ships.
Wood Floor's floors, Fence Posts' posts and Moredoor's doors all burn.
1.2.0: A log in a smoker burns far longer than it did, and how long depends on the tree.
Dense hardwoods last: mangrove, acacia and cherry go furthest, then oak, then birch and poplar.
Spruce is refused. It is resinous, and resin smoke tastes of itself and coats what you are cooking.
Any wooden offcut burns now, not only logs: planks, stairs, slabs, fences, signs, a spare boat.
An offcut is worth what it cost in wood, and still carries the flavour of the tree it came from.
Bamboo is a grass and the nether stems are a fungus; neither is much of a smoking wood.
1.1.0: Every animal worth butchering gives meat, and the bigger ones give two cuts.
A main cut in quantity, with a little of the second alongside it.
Wolves, cats and ocelots are on that list, tame ones included.
Beetroot Vodka: three days in a dark barrel, twice as long as any wine.
It is the only drink here that carries Fire Resistance.
Mead takes two water bottles and a honey bottle, no sugar, and makes two.
Pies take wheat alongside the fruit; sushi no longer does.
Vanilla's pumpkin pie is the Pumpkin Tart, so slice and pie can sit side by side.
1.0.3: A barrel and its block tip read one clock, so a cheese that says it is ready is ready.
A barrel left long enough to reach its top vintage earns an advancement when opened.
1.0.2: Opening the cellar door no longer destroys what is ageing.
A lit room holds a batch where it stands instead of ending it.
The tip says it is being held, rather than leaving a number that has quietly stopped.
1.0.1: With Village Quests installed, a butcher takes apprentices: six lessons for the six things this mod changed that the game never mentions.
The apprenticeship is spaced by days, and finishing it gets you a smoker of your own.
Mead, brewed from honey, water and sugar, fermenting like the wines for Resistance.
A closed barrel says what it is making and how far along.
A hopper filling one starts it; a hopper draining one takes what is ready.
A cellar's darkness is read from the room, not from inside the barrel.
1.0.0: The kitchen opens: smoking as its own craft, cheese aged in a barrel, pies, stews and drinks.
Foods with reasons to exist beyond the size of the bar they restore.
Every food smokes, and beef comes off the animal as the fatty cut.
